days.title: Villages and Industrial Heritage of the Dulce
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: fábrica de papel de los Heros
stops.detail: In the natural park, the old Los Heros paper factory is found as an example of industrial archaeology between the towns of La Cabrera and Aragosa.

stops.name: La Cabrera
stops.detail: It is a 1.5 km linear route, starting from the village of La Cabrera, which heads downstream along the right side of the Dulce river, and offers a series of interpretive elements of the natural environment adapted for the blind.

days.title: The Pelegrina Gorge and Landmark Views
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: hoz de Pelegrina
stops.detail: It traverses the steepest spot in the park, the Pelegrina gorge, descending from the village toward the river.

stops.name: cascada del Gollorio
stops.detail: The Gollorio waterfall can be visited, which is overlooked from the Félix Rodríguez de la Fuente viewpoint, on the GU-118 road, which goes from Torremocha del Campo towards Sigüenza.

days.title: Medieval Fortifications and Sigüenza Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: castillo roquero
stops.detail: On the peak of a hill stands a rock castle, in ruins, from the 11th-12th centuries.

stops.name: Sigüenza
stops.detail: It is a 5 km path, which begins in the medieval city of Sigüenza, and ends in the heart of the natural park, following the Quixote Route, crossing an oak grove.
